acl.adminOnly: Only Workspace administrators can manage access permissions
acl.hint: Access permissions determine who can view or edit this memory.
acl.help: Organization shared memory is readable by Agents in this Workspace by default; Squad shared memory is readable by its members. Agents can edit only their own personal memory, cannot edit shared memory, and cannot access other Agents’ personal memory. Platform users may receive separate edit permissions.
acl.empty: No additional grants. Workspace administrators can still manage memory, and Agents can maintain their own personal memory.
acl.subjectHelp: Enter a user, Agent or Squad ID, such as Agent 40013. For all Agents, enter ALL_AGENTS.
acl.permissionHelp: View: read content. Edit: create, update and delete. Manage: includes edit permissions. Agents can still write only to their own personal memory.

import.help: A missing local file does not mean platform memory was lost. It may not exist yet, may have moved, or may not be a readable regular file. Imported platform memory is retained even if the local file disappears.
